principles: Benches are the trunk, depots are the supply: the tree is organized around making (film, author, podcast, live) inside a dated season; sciences, materials and media histories sit in depot/ and reach the benches only through typed edges (feeds, grounds, needs), so every depot leaf must name at least one bench, kit or case it feeds or show up as a gap cell.

The season is the clock: season/ holds the Oct 1 2026 -> Jan 4 2027 arc (reflection, crescendo, celebration, reset) and the cadence that aligns all four benches; every bench and kit file carries #:season, and dated cells say fixed, typical or verify.

Practice before theory: each bench leaf opens with something a crew can run (run sheet, state machine, pipeline, checklist) and puts explanation after it; ^["try"] blocks are required on bench and kit files.

Foxfire kits: kits/ holds activities done with other people and collected by the doer (interviews, family curriculum maps, dating household media, oral-history keeping); kits feed the owner's site story without containing it.

Whole Earth access to tools: tools/ catalogs what a maker can pick up (Spw editors read from source, the CLI read against this cut, creative tool classes) with access, format openness and as_of; entries describe, never endorse.

One architecture per file, named in the file: timeline ladders, prerequisite DAGs, comparison matrices, state machines, cadence schedules, claim ledgers, glossary lattices, case dossiers, probe batteries, registries, calendars, run sheets, pipelines, dichotomous keys, Llull wheels, Mnemosyne panels and a Mendeleev gap table; lab/script-architectures registers which constructs each one stresses.

Claims are statements, not prose: keystone claims carry #:claim status, a src_* reference, and as_of wherever a platform, market or guideline can move; market and platform facts follow Wikidata rank (preferred, normal, deprecated) instead of being overwritten.

Internal history is a production record: cases/internal treats plan cards, episode commits, the commit gate, editor and CLI arcs, and this cut's own generation-and-review as dossiers on equal footing with well-known cases.

Wonder is generated from closed sets and gaps are shown: Llull wheels rotate closed vocabularies into question stems, probe batteries name the anchor a probe would update, and the gap table leaves empty cells with predicted properties rather than inventing filler.

Harm firewall: physiology, nursing and community-health material is written as mechanisms and curricula, never as personal advice; quarantined raw content is described in provenance/harms by harm class and line, never restated.
Trails are Memex paths and publishing bundles: each trail orders anchors across branches and its ^["bundle"] expands into a readable chapbook; computed clusters stay prompts.
Borges caution: the tree is one of several views; facets, typed edges and trails provide the others, and no directory name claims to be the natural kind of its contents.

risks: Currency: platform facts (LIVE eligibility gates, gift and diamond values, KU per-page rates, Edison platform shares, theatrical windows) move quarterly and sit near or past the writers' knowledge horizon; without as_of + rank + verify status they will read as settled.

Harm leakage: nursing, physiology-parallel and community-care files can drift back into advice (doses, protocols, remediation, diet); the harms register must describe classes without restating the advice, and writers must not copy raw lines into new files.
Well-known cases touch real people and events (film labor disputes, live-commerce tax enforcement, set-safety incidents); dossiers must stay on the public record with sources and no speculation.
The workshop angle can over-rotate toward the benches, leaving depots as thin supply lists; the rule that every depot leaf names what it feeds, plus the gap table, is the counterweight.

Tool support lags the contract: spw graph reports ~"file.spw#anchor" refs as broken and treats @name roots as nodes, the LSP ignores ~#lens(), $% parses as two ops, and bias edges are not graphed; validation must use spw resolve/atlas and the archcheck script, not graph counts.

Size: 313 planned files and about 40k estimated lines is roughly 2.8x the raw 14,226 lines; furniture (header, emit, provenance, edges, concepts) can crowd content unless indexes stay short and keystone frames carry the substance.

Anchor uniqueness and path-substring rules are easy to break across 16 writers (e.g. 'workshops', 'stops', 'props', 'expression', 'lifestyle', 'phased'); a pre-merge check must run over the whole cut.

Generational labels and 'American worries' framing can drift into political or demographic generalization; cohort boundaries must be marked interpretive and worries stated with poll sources, not asserted.
The streamers-as-first-users claim is a hypothesis; if written as fact it becomes marketing inside a reference corpus.
Internal cases rely on rewritten history (episodes-only canon rewrite): commit dates and counts describe the rewritten log, not original work timing.

The ocean question: lab/clustering-hybrid must stay questions; ocean is also a runtime stability channel, a cache-tier contract and a hard-coded @biome path, so presenting the hybrid as a replacement would mislead.

Wonder generators can re-inflate unique lenses and handles (the raw had 165 lenses in 167 uses and 337 unique handles); closed sets and registered handles must be enforced by the validator, not by convention.
